shots.intent: 首屏建立上身效果与主色基调，宽松垂坠版型直观呈现

style.backgroundSystem: deep-gray gradient sweep #4A4A4A to #2E2E2E for the studio hero; white arched interior with navy curtain #F2F1EF and #46557D for life scenes; high-key matte surfaces mint #D6E9E4, pale ice-blue #DCE9F0 and pure white #FFFFFF for flat lays and info cards
style.direction: cool clean sport-basic menswear campaign: studio hero on deep gray, white arched interior life scenes, high-key ice-tone flat lays and craft macros

style.lightingSystem: soft key from front-left with gentle falloff on the hero; diffuse window light in scenes; shadowless top softbox for flat lays
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: a cool, clean sport-basic menswear campaign. The studio hero sits on a deep-gray gradient sweep #4A4A4A to #2E2E2E with a generic young male model in a relaxed drapey ice-silk tee, soft key from front-left and gentle falloff. Life scenes use a white arched interior #F2F1EF with a navy curtain accent #46557D under diffuse window light. Flat lays and color charts sit on high-key matte mint #D6E9E4 or pale ice-blue #DCE9F0 shot top-down with shadowless soft light. Macro fabric shots must reveal fine breathable knit with natural swirl folds, never glossy. Typography: bold Chinese headlines in information blue #1E6FD0 or charcoal #1C1C1E with light gray supporting copy and small English section labels; thin-line circular evaporating-arrows badges in pale blue or white. Tech cards keep the top-photo bottom-copy split; colorways cycle model recolor, top-down flat lay and hanger lineup; craft details are 45-degree top-down macros with a bottom caption strip. Strip all brand marks, logos, tech names and model identity; keep only the young-male indoor-lifestyle role.
noDrift: no warm sunset or outdoor sports scenes
no brand logos, names or patented tech names
model stays a generic young male in indoor lifestyle
style.presentationRules: model occupies 55-70% with 15-25% whitespace; tech cards fixed top-photo bottom-copy split; colorways cycle three views (model recolor, top-down flat lay, hanger lineup); craft details always 45-degree top-down macro with a bottom caption strip; size charts use zebra rows
style.surfaceSystem: matte ice-silk knit micro-texture: macros must reveal fine breathable knit and natural drape swirls, never glossy
